claims.content: The Auctioneer reviews the historical auction performance data for a specific SKU, including metrics such as sales count, churn rate, number of bids, and winner information, to evaluate the item's market success.

goal.raw_text: The Auctioneer reviews the historical auction performance data for a specific SKU, including metrics such as sales count, churn rate, number of bids, and winner information, to evaluate the item's market success.

claims.content: Auctioneer
The system must contain historical auction performance data for the specific SKU (Product ID) being queried.
The Auctioneer must know the Product ID of the item to review its performance.
The Auctioneer enters a specific Product ID into the search field on the SKU History page and clicks the 'Go' button.

trigger.raw_text: The Auctioneer enters a specific Product ID into the search field on the SKU History page and clicks the 'Go' button.

claims.content: The Auctioneer navigates to the SKU History page within the Auction Administration application.
The Auctioneer enters the specific Product ID into the search field labeled 'Search by Product ID'.
The Auctioneer clicks the 'Go' button to initiate the search for the SKU's auction history.

The system displays the search results in two sections: a top section with summary data (Product ID, description, costs, auction history stats) and a bottom section with detailed line items for each auction instance.
The Auctioneer reviews the displayed metrics, including sales count, churn rate, number of bids, and winner information, to evaluate the item's market success.
The system displays the search results for the specific SKU in two distinct sections: a top summary section and a bottom detailed history section.

The top section displays summary data including Product ID, description, product type, unit cost, price (P1), thumbnail image, auction history statistics (scheduled count, sales count, churn rate), buyer's name, available quantities (auction, red, white), and active date.

The bottom section displays a list of individual auction instances for the SKU, showing details such as auction status, sequence, start/end dates, reserve amount, high bid, number of bids, and winner/high bidder information.
